## In preparation

First author:

- Long-term effects of macrophyte removal on aquatic biodiversity in rivers and lakes
- Influence of wetland restoration and alteration on GHG emissions across wetland types:
  a meta-analysis
- Current knowledge on the impact of coastal wetland restoration on biodiversity:
  insights from a meta-analysis

Several further co-authored manuscripts are in the writing phase, covering prokaryotic
community structure in restored coastal wetlands, dissolved organic matter dynamics in
European wetlands, seagrass meadow restoration indicators, the Camargue case study, and a
trait-based framework for aquatic macrophyte life forms.
